items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Cali Piggott. ... Yeah, more like the original than any other. But he don't play long, because the fellas won't let him play it, they make him play the Dixaland style. So he's practically dying out now.

ctx.x: Who has the oldest style, do you think? If you could think of all the drummers, who's the one that has the oldest style?
Cali Piggott? Yeah. He plays more like the, like you were saying?
